title: A manifest carrying only the required members is a conforming Lens Manifest
rationale: Fixes the floor of the "conforming Lens Manifest" target. Everything above the five required members is optional, and a suite that only ever validated rich manifests would not notice a schema that had started demanding one of them.

requirement.text: A conforming Lens Manifest is a JSON document that validates against schemas/lens-manifest.schema.json and satisfies every normative requirement of this document.
